children: The South Korean won is poised to strengthen further against the dollar in 2027, says Chris Turner at ING. The Bank of Korea's notably upbeat assessment of the domestic economy, the prospect of another rate increase next year to match expected Federal Reserve hikes, and wider current-account surpluses bode well for the local currency, the global head of markets writes in a note. The BOK expects the current account surplus to reach $500 billion in 2026 and $540 billion in 2027--sharply higher than the record $123 billion surplus in 2025, he notes. The won is up roughly 7% against the dollar this year, outperforming its Asian peers. The dollar is down 0.2% at 1,341.04 won, FactSet data shows. ING expects the dollar to trade at 1,275.00 won in 4Q 2027. (kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
